## The readiness checklist for the scoring policy rollout.

This lede runs long on purpose: it frames the checklist below in the three or four sentences an author would actually write when the slide is the first one in a section and needs to carry context. It names the audience, the deadline, and the reason the list exists at all, which together is most of a paragraph. The point of the probe is that this block is masthead material and hoists to the cover, so the body pages get it back as headroom.

- Scoring policy signed by the council chair
- Backtest delta published against the shipped scores
- Runbook updated with the new weights and the rollback path
- On-call briefed, with the policy hash in the incident template
- Customer-facing changelog drafted and reviewed by support
- Regional residency review closed with no open findings
- Data-retention job re-pointed at the new signal store
- Dashboard queries updated for the renamed score column

This closing note is also long: it is a below-note, so it belongs to the content immediately above it, and it rides the last body page one size down rather than repeating on every page of the run.
